text.title: Difference Cannot Be Escaped
text.body:
Non-duality preserves distinction within the appearing-act from which its terms arise. The danger lies in the amnesia that follows the cut.

text.title: Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, and Hephaestus
text.body:
Ares and Aphrodite give the logics a body. War separates, contests, and spends difference; love attracts, joins, and makes relation fertile. Their dangerous encounter bears Harmonia.

text.title: Zero Changes Its Role
text.body:
Polar dia-ballein retains zero as the axis of opposed values; its collapsed operations make zero a cancellation or assign the whole span to one pole. The measurable two asks what it amounts to once it includes the relation that generates it: 2+2² = 6 = 4+2.
